outcome: Log weekly new postings, substitutable clusters (e.g. writing, translation) x after ChatGPT
population_or_market: 116 skill clusters (12 substitutable, 59 complementary, 45 unaffected by LLMs) on one anonymous global freelancing platform; graphic design sits mainly in the CONTROL group
data_source: Daily postings via API (Online Labour Index), Jan 2021-Sep 2023, analysed weekly; several million postings (over 3 million cited in the Discussion)

caveat: Text-based substitutability only: image generators were excluded from the labelling (Sec. 3.2.4), and graphic design is a control cluster, so there is NO estimate for visual art. Robustness models 2-4: -0.29 (0.09), -0.28 (0.09), -0.28 (0.09). Demand-side outcome: not comparable with supply-side outcomes in Hui et al.
